title: OpenTumorBoard: A Real-World Benchmark of Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Discussion Trajectories
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce OpenTumorBoard, a benchmark with 611 patient cases and 19,157 discussion turns across ten specialist roles, transcribed from 12,534 minutes of publicly available tumor board recordings on YouTube.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark evaluates two settings: SPECIALIST TURN, in which an LLM responds to a clinically significant question posed during a real discussion, and BOARD SIMULATION, in which it generates an entire back-and-forth discussion and reaches a consensus on therapy recommendations, surgical plans, next actions and clinical trial matching.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning improve performance on a held-out test set, suggesting that real-world discussion trajectories can support model adaptation.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation of 14 general-purpose frontier and medical LLMs reveals substantial limitations: the best models score 3.43 out of 5 in clinical equivalence to specialist answers and 2.78 out of 5 in alignment with recorded board conclusions.

declaredVenue: Preprint. Includes supplementary material. Added dataset and leaderboard links
